subject: english
prompt: A guide says a plant needs water to stay alive. One student stops watering a plant, and it later wilts. Which conclusion is most careful?

options.text: The guide proves every plant wilts at exactly the same speed.
The plant must have wilted before the student stopped watering it.
Lack of water may have contributed to the wilting, but this observation alone does not rule out other factors.
Water is the only factor that can affect a plant.

answer.explanation: 缺水可能促成萎凋，但題目沒有排除其他因素，故最謹慎的結論為 C。

solutionStrategy: 把觀察到的先後和可能機制分開；結論強度不可超過證據能支持的範圍。
solutionSteps: 已知觀察是停止澆水後，這株植物後來萎凋。
課文提供「植物需要水」的機制，讓缺水成為合理的可能原因。
但題目沒有交代光照、溫度、根部或對照植株，不能排除其他因素。
因此用 may have contributed 表示可能有貢獻，而不宣稱唯一原因；選 C。
檢查 A、D 的絕對字眼 every、only，以及 B 倒置時間順序，皆超出證據。
